signals.text: Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Own product strategy, execution, and roadmap prioritization for the Patient Experience portfolio
Lead PM and UX teams accountable for patient experience, patient payment, cashpay, and SMB business experience product lines
Own the entire idea-to-ship lifecycle — from discovery and problem framing through implementation-ready requirements — across Patient Experience, Patient Payment, Online…
Build outcomes-based roadmaps organized around business and customer outcomes, not feature lists, with clear KPI ownership per initiative
Drive KPI-driven feature selection, using data and evidence rather than opinion to decide what gets built and in what order
